1. Read the <span id="assignment.79.1"/> column and **write down** which node the gateway is running on: you will want proof it moved
2. Click the  on the far right side of its row
3. Select <span id="assignment.79.2"/> from the context menu
4. Choose a different, safe target node from the dropdown list
5. Click <span id="assignment.74.2"/>

Behind the scenes, <span id="assignment.2.3"/> copies the VM's live memory pages to the target node over the network, tracking and re-copying any pages the busy gateway dirties mid-flight, until it can freeze, flip, and resume execution on the new node in a fraction of a second.
